_README: The field map /job apply --batch records while filling a form, one per job, written to
refill.js — the script that puts the same answers back into the same form later, in the
user's own browser. Delete this _README key in the real file.
Every value here must come from jobs/input/profile/master-resume.md or
jobs/input/config/application-answers.md. A question with no answer on file goes in
'gaps' and is left blank on the form — it is never guessed.
_frame: URL fragment of the iframe holding the form, when it is in one. Omit otherwise.
_resume_file: What the user must attach by hand — scripts cannot fill a file input.

fields.label: Are you authorized to work in the United States?
Will you now or in the future require sponsorship?
fields.name: question_4002

fields.label: I agree to the privacy policy
Why do you want to work here?
fields.value: <drafted from the tailored resume and the JD — nothing not already true>

_fields: label    — required. The question as a human reads it. This is the fallback locator when
the selector goes stale, which ATS ids reliably do, so keep it verbatim.
selector — CSS selector observed in the live form. Optional but preferred.
name     — the input's name attribute; for radios it is how the group is found.
type     — text | email | tel | textarea | select | radio | checkbox | file
value    — what to enter. For checkbox, true/false. For file, the file name only.
source   — where the answer came from. Free text, for the audit trail.

gaps.label: Desired salary
gaps.why: no salary line in application-answers.md — left blank rather than guessed

notes: Anything the run wants the user to know before submitting: a field the form rejected,
a question that appeared only after another answer, a login it could not get past.
